fundamentals.name: Applied Optoelectronics, Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Applied Optoelectronics, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of fiber-optic networking products in the United States, Taiwan, and China. The company offers optical modules, optical filters, lasers, laser components, subassemblies, transmitters and transceivers, turn-key equipment, headend, node, and distribution equipment, as well as amplifiers. It sells its products to internet data center operators, cable television, telecom equipment manufacturers, fiber-to-the-home, and internet service providers through its direct and indirect sales channels. Applied Optoelectronics, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Sugar Land, Texas.

judgment.summary: Rapidly growing revenue and strong analyst estimates are offset by current unprofitability and a high valuation.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter missed EPS estimates; next earnings date is 2026-08-06.
positives: Revenue growth 51.4% YoY, with analyst estimates for current Q and FY showing explosive growth.
PEG ratio of 0.78 suggests growth may justify the current valuation.
Strong balance sheet with a current ratio of 3.83 and quick ratio of 2.85.
negatives: Operating and profit margins are negative (-8.6% and -8.5% respectively).
Return on equity and assets are also negative.
High forward P/E of 42.80 and Price/Sales of 32.33 indicate a premium valuation.
Free cash flow is negative, indicating cash burn.

news.paragraph: Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI) is seeing significant positive attention following news of its substantial Texas capital expenditure increase, driven by major AI and DOCSIS wins. This expansion, coupled with strong demand for its 800G and 1.6T products, has fueled an optics rally, with AAOI shares climbing. Analysts are bullish on the company's growth prospects, citing the ramp-up in high-speed networking technology.
